title: About Me
content:
Software Engineer based in Marrakech, currently working at Invinio while completing a Web Development diploma expected in June 2026. I build full-stack web products with React, Astro, Laravel, FastAPI, and TypeScript, with a strong focus on accessibility, performance, and clear user experiences.

My professional work spans frontend development, headless CMS integrations, SEO optimization, WCAG-focused testing, and quality improvements for accessibility platforms. I enjoy working across both product details and system behavior: debugging, reviewing implementations, improving UI, validating SaaS engine features, and making digital experiences more reliable.

Beyond client and platform work, I build AI-driven applications such as Coursezy, a learning platform with intelligent assistance, and hackathon projects around multilingual translation and legal assistance. My goal is to grow as a full-stack software engineer who combines practical engineering, AI integration, accessibility, and digital strategy to create products that are useful, scalable, and inclusive.
